branches.conclusion: Complete current graduate admissions and 2026–2027 College of Business catalog inventories list MBA and a certificate, with no relevant academic research doctorate. The recruitment advertisement mentions DBA teaching, but current award status is unresolved and DBA is a separate credential category. Operations-related MBA courses do not establish a doctorate.

The complete current graduate admissions inventory and catalog graduate-school list contain no engineering graduate provision. Listed doctoral areas are psychology, education, health professions and seminary study; no Operations or Industrial Engineering doctorate is established.

sources.note: Read the complete employer-posted George Fox University advertisement, Assistant/Associate Professor of Business (Business Analytics & Quantitative Methods). It identifies the College of Business dean as supervisor and a teaching position, not a separately constituted department. The advertisement mentions MBA and DBA teaching; applicant doctoral qualifications are not programme evidence.
Read the full current undergraduate Business Analytics Certificate page, its five curricular areas, prerequisites, and capstone. It is an undergraduate certificate, not doctoral provision.
Read the full current academic gateway separating undergraduate, accelerated online, and graduate routes; official identity and Newberg campus footer observed.

Read the complete current graduate programme inventory across Behavioral Health, Business, Education and Teaching, Healthcare, and Portland Seminary. Business lists MBA only; no engineering graduate offering is listed. The listed doctorates concern psychology, education, health professions and seminary study, rather than Operations.

Read every displayed BUSG course description in the 2026–2027 catalog. BUSG 554 Smart Logistics & Ops Excellence explicitly concerns operational systems and supply chains; BUSG 606 concerns supply-chain process optimization. These are business courses, not a named doctoral research route.

Read the complete current College of Business programmes page: Business Analytics Certificate and MBA only. This current catalog does not list the DBA mentioned in the recruitment advertisement. No closure date inferred.

Read the complete 2026–2027 graduate catalog introduction and all four graduate-school categories: Behavioral Science and Health Professions, College of Business, College of Education and Portland Seminary. No engineering graduate school or programme appears in this inventory.

limitations: This conclusion is bounded to the complete current graduate inventories read on the check date. The job advertisement’s DBA reference is retained as a discrepancy; it is not converted into a PhD or assigned an inferred closure date. No relevant research doctorate is verified from MBA course content.
